answer: Disclosure is low-cost for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which pays 10 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. Because the fable register is reconciled against the tundra funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the walnut audit publishes the forfeited amount. An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 10 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
